A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Uni-MMMU benchmark and contain 17 readable pages, including Appendices A and B. Complete text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the results, figures, tables, and mathematical content.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations in Table 2, evaluator-agreement measurements in Table 3, and intermediate-state ablation results in Table 4.

after.justification: v2 retains these original evaluations and ablations, with several revised Sliding Puzzle accuracy values in Tables 2 and 4.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction, interleaved inference procedures, and parser/model-as-a-judge evaluation methods in Section 3 and Appendix A are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 885-instance benchmark covering Maze, Sliding Puzzle, Geometry, Jigsaw, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Code Rendering. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same six unified and six specialized models. Table 4 retains GPT-image, GPT-4.1, GPT, and GPT w/ GT in the same comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported metrics, parsing thresholds, prompting procedures, model settings, and 150-output evaluator-validation sample are identical. No protocol revision accompanies the changed scores.

E4.justification: Table 4 revises the Sliding results supporting its existing ablation of generated versus ground-truth intermediate states. The ablation conditions, questions tested, and qualitative failure analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including the Cohen's-kappa evaluator-agreement measurements in Table 3. No run counts, seeds, uncertainty intervals, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: In Tables 2 and 4, GPT4.1 + GPT-image's Sliding text step/sample accuracy changes from 25.1/1.2 to 25.6/2.4. Table 4's GPT w/ GT Sliding result changes from 34.7/2.4 to 34.7/3.6. Other reported results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The unique-solution requirements, scoring definitions, and mathematical examples are identical. No assumption, proof, or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about the eight-task benchmark, dual-level evaluation, and synergy between generation and understanding.

C2.justification: The interpretations of intermediate-state benefits and generation bottlenecks in Sections 4.2–4.4 are unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitations concerning task scope, synthetic data, static imagery, and model-based judges.

D1.justification: Appendices A and B retain identical construction, prompting, and parsing details, NVIDIA A800 hardware, approximately 48 GPU-days, and default sampling settings. Project access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the benchmark positioning in Table 1, and the cited works and reference list are unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1, dated 15 Oct 2025, to v2, dated 25 Feb 2026. Apart from numerical result updates, the wording and document organization are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10, all table structures and captions, and page layout are unchanged. The numerical updates within Tables 2 and 4 do not alter their presentation.

improvement.justification: The localized Sliding score revisions in Tables 2 and 4 leave the experimental design, principal conclusions, clarity, and reproducibility information essentially unchanged. With all other substantive content, including the appendices, retained, these updates establish no meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
